title.narrative: SUPPORT TO INTEGRATED CLIMATE SMART LIVELIHOOD

description.narrative: The objective of the climate smart livelihood programme is to contribute to strengthening the resilience of vulnerable communities' livelihoods to climate change, alleviate chronic food insecurity, and restore natural resource systems in Tigray region. This is a programme designed as part of post –war recovery and reconstruction programme. In addition to the livelihood diversification through Agricultural Research Institute there is ongoing research on Natural Resource Management including establishment of tree nurseries for raising trees for afforestation and reforestation. Bureau of Agriculture also providing capacity building training to beneficiaries and is supporting for plantation of trees to restore degraded lands. These interventions have potential contribution for enhancing carbon sequestration. The programme targets 75,378 households, including 19,844 female-headed households, 6,614 adolescence girls and 6,616 youth who are going to be involved and benefit from the programme.
